question: What is the value of (1 over 4×3 over 4÷11 over 4of 2 over 5) ÷ (3 over 4÷ 12 over 3of4 over 5) - (1 over 2-1 over 2×1 over 4) ?
solution:
**Given:**

(1 over 4×3 over 4÷11 over 4of 2 over 5) ÷ (3 over 4÷ 12 over 3of4 over 5) - (1 over 2-1 over 2×1 over 4)

**Concept used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/DHv7z4pPj_Yn8sN-w2CfqHCC7kjJszE5Ocj5qmuV0ds0JD7XwrghHxRpPUJOXniHzhbIoIUBSHl1yGGnXCwG3milQiRVvSDn6Q6mCZZpsyJhiC0eyfaluNK4I3sojAkFQVEktYQgTp-k28w_IbngcA] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ (1/4 × 3/4 ÷ 5/4 of 2/5) ÷ (3/4 ÷ 5/3 of 4/5) - (1/2 - 1/2 × 1/4)

⇒ (1/4 × 3/4 ÷ 1/2) ÷ (3/4 ÷ 4/3) - (1/2 - 1/8)

⇒ (1/4 × 3/2) ÷ (9/16) - (3/8)

⇒ (3/8) ÷ (9/16) - (3/8)

⇒ 3/8 × 16/9 - 3/8

⇒ 2/3 - 3/8 = (16 - 9)/24 = 7/24

**∴ The value of the given expression is 7/24. **
